scope: 31 user-supplied pairs / 58 existing native embedded JSON documents; offline comparison; coverage is not accuracy

new_rules.rule: nonempty normalized whole product title equality
new_rules.normalization: HTML entities, Unicode NFKC, whitespace collapse; do not remove model/capacity/quantity tokens

new_rules.rule: manufacturer model exact complete token in AU visible product title/text equals Rakuten manufacturer model attribute
fields: Rakuten itemInfoSku.attributes or sku[].attributes, title=メーカー型番
new_rules.excluded: AU24 A2147 only appears in image paths; not counted as prose model evidence

image_candidate.rule: entire unique gallery filename-stem set equality, at least 3 images
image_candidate.status: candidate requiring broader evaluation, not asserted as a safe automatic rule
image_candidate.warning: filename stems, not image byte equality

rejected_or_no_yield.rule: at least two shared gallery image filenames
rejected_or_no_yield.reason: AU03 dryer and RA06 iron share 35279021om2 and 35290048-sab2; this alone falsely merges different products
no qualifying full-field matches in these pairs

rejected_or_no_yield.rule: direct counterpart-product URL or exact shared external manufacturer URL
rejected_or_no_yield.reason: not found in the saved native JSON/raw HTML inspected
